author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at gameplay from Quilt in this trailer for the upcoming puzzle game. Create a beautiful quilt one patch at a time. Solve handcrafted puzzles inspired by Picross, Minesweeper, and jigsaw puzzles, and uncover the hidden rules of the world through logic and experimentation. Quilt will be available on PC. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Quilt - Official Steam Demo Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Feed the Scorchpot launch trailer for this upcoming dice roguelike about feeding a dragon for twenty years. Roll ingredients, build your island, and fuse absurd recipes into combos that break the score wide open. Miss a meal and you're next on the menu. Feed the Scorchpot will be available on PC on August 20, 2026.
title: Feed the Scorchpot - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Reveal Trailer for Sign of Silence: 99 Nights, a first-person survival horror game developed by Renderise. Players must survive 99 nights in a cursed forest filled with terrifying monsters and secrets to reveal. Gather resources, tend to the camp, and take on the darkness alone or with friends in co-op. Sign of Silence: 99 Nights is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Sign of Silence: 99 Nights - Official Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the 1.0 Launch Trailer for Warhounds, a turn-based tactical RPG developed by Everplay DMCC. Players will take on intense missions as an elite mercenary team. Enlist new fighters, upgrade the base, and take out enemies with ease. Warhounds is available now on PC (Steam).
title: Warhounds - Official 1.0 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Gameplay Release Date Trailer for Wild Ice, a third-person action-adventure tower defense game developed by Journey Bound Games. Players will take to the ice to defend a small town from certain undead doom. Traverse a frozen landscape as hockey players, start furnaces across town, and hurl slap shots at incoming zombies. Wild Ice is launching on August 19 for PC (Steam).
title: Wild Ice - Official Gameplay Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the latest Holey Ship trailer for this upcoming chaotic co-op party game for up to four mates running a dysfunctional boat repair shop. Holey Ship will be available on PC via Steam on August 25, 2026.

Customers arrive with all sorts of issues with their boat — broken planks, dirty hulls, low fuel just to name a few. Unfortunately… these customers don’t have much patience and if you take too long, they’ll leave the shop a bad one-star review.

Work together to repair holes, replace broken parts, carry tools and materials, solve fast-paced minigames, and complete customer requests before their ships sail off angrily. As the chaos grows, so do the challenges!
title: Holey Ship - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Grilluminati announcement trailer for this upcoming online co-op action game. In Grilluminati, up to 4 cultists must serve one of 3 rivalling gods through bloodshed, worship, and increasingly demanding rituals with increasingly disturbing ingredients. Every shift is a co-op cult operation. Grilluminati will be available on PC.
title: Grilluminati - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Trailblazers is available now in MapleStory Worlds on PC. Watch the Trailblazers trailer for this tactical dungeon crawler game developed by Cometa Studio with the support of Nexon. Trailblazers is a new tactical dungeon crawler that reimagines the MapleStory universe through strategic, grid-based gameplay, where every movement represents a strategic and crucial decision. The story immerses the player into a new adventure where they can choose from different characters, each with passive skills and unique attributes that influence the gameplay strategy.
title: MapleStory Worlds: Trailblazers - Official Launch Trailer

description: Take a look at the 'Traffic' Campaign First Look Trailer for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, the upcoming installment to the hit first-person action shooter franchise developed by Infinity Ward. Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is launching on October 23 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam), with Campaign early access starting on October 16 for those who pre-order.
title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 - Official 'Traffic' Campaign First Look Trailer

description: Don't miss the New Features Overview Trailer for Persona 4 Revival, the upcoming remake to the hit classic turn-based RPG developed by Atlus. Access new voiced events, new music, and new combat elements such as Send Flying, Baton Pass, and Prime Time. Persona 4 Revival is launching on February 18 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Cloud, and PC (Xbox on PC and Steam).

description: Omen is available now on Steam. Watch the Omen launch trailer for this top-down sci-fi extraction shooter game to see gameplay and more. title: Omen - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Release Date Trailer for Sprawl Zero, a fast-paced first-person action shooter developed by Maeth. Players will take on enemy after enemy across a cyberpunk city that hangs in the balance against brutal military rule. Wield over 40 weapons, harness the power of a suite of augments, and dispatch those along the way. Sprawl Zero is launching on September 8 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).

Learn about paths, progression, building philosophy schools, resource extraction, refining materials to grow cities, trading, and much more. Theos: Cities of Myth will be available on PC in 2026.
title: Theos: Cities of Myth - Official Gameplay Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Hellbound Inc is available now on Steam. Watch the Hellbound Inc launch trailer for this precision platformer game. Welcome to Hellbound Inc, the nightmare fulfilment center where your CEO sold out to Satan for. Now you’re stuck fulfilling demonic delivery quotas, dodging fire-spewing belts, haunted forklifts, and impossible deadlines. Navigate the chaos of shifting layouts, outrun Hell’s worst managers, and escape eternal overtime.
title: Hellbound Inc - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Santa Barbara Games, a new developer comprised of former Bethesda, Riot, EA, and other talent, has announced its first game: Voidwood, a 1-4-player fantasy co-op survival horror game with a decidedly Studio Ghibli-esque art style. In it, you and your friends play as children lost in a cursed forest, scavenging for supplies and crafting tools by day in order to survive and escape at night when The Beast, an unkillable monstrous force, is unleashed.  Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3694420/Voidwood/?utm_source=press&utm_medium=factsheet&utm_campaign=announce_aug2026
title: Voidwood: Official Announcement Trailer

description:
Unleash wicked new powers. Fight as Spider-Man in Marvel Future Fight, available now on iOS and Android.

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's your look at the Isles of Innsmouth teaser trailer for this upcoming minimalist Lovecraftian strategy game about building cities to appease the Elder Gods. Place buildings to grow your settlement, unlock new structures, and discover synergies to improve your score. Or just relax and build in creative sandbox mode to enjoy the cozy-horror vibes. Isles of Innsmouth will be available on PC via Steam.
title: Isles of Innsmouth - Official Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Here's your look at the Job Simulator: Human Relations announcement trailer for this upcoming officially licensed flat-screen co-op physics comedy game from FarBridge (the studio behind Homeworld: Vast Reaches and credits in RWBY Grimm Eclipse), developed in collaboration with IP holder Owlchemy Labs. 

Set in 2050, after human employment has been completely terminated, Job Simulator: Human Relations takes players back to the Museum of Human Employment for its latest living-history exhibit. The robot curators behind it learned everything they know about office life from social media posts, corporate training videos, and toxic productivity gurus. Needless to say, their recreation of work is…not accurate. 

Job Simulator: Human Relations will be available on PC. A Kickstarter campaign is out now.
title: Job Simulator: Human Relations - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Session Trailer for Farming Camp, a 2D pixel-based farming adventure game developed by Innerfire Studios. Players can get a look at the game's moment-to-moment gameplay, highlighting mini-games, management systems, characters, and more. Become an Evertree farmer in Farming Camp, launching on September 24 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).
title: Farming Camp - Official Session Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Over the Hill gets a new trailer and a release date. Drive iconic 4x4 vehicles from the 60s to 80s by yourself or with friends through challenging trails and beautiful scenery. Over the Hill will be available on PC via Steam on October 14, 2026. It will also be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and Nintendo Switch 2 in 2027.

author: GameTrailers
description:
Here's a look at the F-22A Raptor, Gripen E, Typhoon, and more aircraft in this latest Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve trailer for the upcoming flight simulation combat game. Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and Steam on October 2, 2026.

In Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve, soar through the skies and rise above every challenge to earn your place among the elite. Engage in intense aerial combat to dominate the battlefield with powerful weapons. Experience a breathtaking campaign filled with high-stakes missions, hard choices, and deep squad connections.
title: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve - Official The Art of Aircraft Trailer

description:
